questions.why: One c and two s's: necessary. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: “A person who speaks many languages”
questions.why: A polyglot is a person who knows and uses several languages. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: “She ______ in this hospital since 2015.”
questions.why: An action from a past point continuing now, with 'since': present perfect (continuous). GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the meaning of the idiom “to burn the midnight oil”:
opts: to work or study late into the night

questions.q: Choose the correct word: “The new health policy will ____ rural clinics positively.”
questions.why: 'Affect' is a verb meaning to influence; 'effect' is mostly a noun. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the error: “Neither of the two answers are correct.”
questions.why: 'Neither of' takes a singular verb: 'is correct'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the correct conjunction: “Both the doctor ____ the nurse were present.”
questions.why: Correlative pair: both ... and. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “If he works hard, he ____ the examination.”
questions.why: First conditional: if + present simple, will + base verb. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q:
Rearrange the sentences P, Q, R and S to form a meaningful paragraph:
P. The patient took the medicine regularly.
Q. The doctor examined the patient.
R. The doctor then wrote a prescription.
S. Soon the patient recovered completely.
questions.why: Examination, prescription, medication, recovery. GPSC-style practice item.
